answer_1.quote: We investigate three exemplar applications, including basic language modeling, domain adaptation, and generating citations for question answering ... We evaluate on WikiText-103, LawMT, and ASQA datasets.
answer_1.outputs: generated continuations, domain‑adapted text, and citations embedded in answers

answer_2.quote: We use four automatic evaluation metrics to measure the quality of the generated texts: (i) MAUVE, (ii) Rep‑n, (iii) Diversity, and (iv) Perplexity (and also report latency).

answer_3.quote: We also employ GPT-4 (Achiam et al., 2023) for further assessment. ... GPT-4 is asked to evaluate the generated texts by considering fluency, coherence, informativeness, and grammar. ... we include another corresponding triplet to mitigate order bias.

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation To gain further assessment, we also run human evaluation on a random sample of 100 generations. Annotators are asked to choose which one is better (in terms of fluency, coherence, informativeness, and grammar).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators choose the better continuation based on fluency, coherence, informativeness, and grammar.
